parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The language of the description for the configuration items.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data source.

parameters.name: withConfig
parameters.description: Specifies whether to obtain the specific configuration items of the data source.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute get-mms-data-source --source-id 2000015 --with-config true --lang en_US --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/mms/datasources/2000015 --region cn-hangzhou --withConfig true --lang en_US --header "Content-Type=application/json"
